title: MZ Alice and the Red Queen

posts.author: Soul_Narrative_Games
posts.body:
When Alice opens a toy box she lost, she is pulled into another world by the Red Queen. The Red Queen wants to use Alice's body to become free from the box, but her husband convinces her to play a game to see if Alice is capable of returning to normal. Will Alice win this game, or will the Red Queen take over her body?
This game was made for the GMTK Game Jam 2024:
https://itch.io/jam/gmtk-2024
This game was made in RPG Maker MZ.
Controls
Arrows Key: Move
Space Bar or Z key: Confirm options
Spoiler:
Characters
Alice: A fun-loving care-free kid who loves life and has a heart of gold. She can be naive at times.
Red Queen: Generally a very selfish person, she also loves a good challenge.
